description: Estimate shipping prices and delivery timeframes for the current cart in a destination city_id (use search_cities first for non-Moscow cities). Optionally pass pickup_point_id + pickup_point_carrier_id from search_pickup_points to price a specific pickup point. Returns courier, pickup-point, and carrier options in the city's currency.

city_id.description: Destination city ID (use search_cities to look up). Default: 414 (Moscow).

pickup_point_id.description: Optional pickup_point_id from search_pickup_points to get an exact quote for that point.

name: estimate_delivery

is_local_courier.description: True for Moscow-area cities (store courier + free Moscow warehouse self-pickup are available).

from_price.description: True when the price is a lower bound ('from N').

key.description: Option key: moscow (store courier), pickup_point (cheapest carrier pickup point), selected (chosen point), or carrier code (cdek, yandex, kit, energia, etc.).

paid_to_carrier.description: True when shipping is paid directly to the carrier at pickup (not added to the store order total).

price.description: Estimated delivery price in the response's currency (0 when free).
